January 7, 2026 | Natural Disasters Summary 

Oujda, Morocco | Rare snowfall blanketed the city for the first time in about 25 years. Up to 2 cm fell in the city center and 7–10 cm in nearby villages, caused by a cold air intrusion and low-pressure system.

West Halmahera, Indonesia | Severe flooding and landslides after prolonged heavy rain killed two people, damaged or destroyed hundreds of homes, and forced the evacuation of about 1,500 residents across multiple districts.

Davao Oriental, Philippines | A strong offshore earthquake struck Mindanao, triggering evacuations in several communities. No casualties or major damage were reported, but authorities warned of aftershocks.

Albay Province, Philippines | Volcanic activity at Mayon intensified, prompting authorities to raise the alert level to 3. Lava dome collapse, ash plumes, and pyroclastic flows led to mass evacuations around the volcano.

#Flooding #Earthquake #Volcano #Snowfall #Evacuations #ExtremeWeather #NaturalDisasters
#ALLATRA
